key_concepts: Earthquakes generate seismic waves that reveal Earth's interior
Body waves travel through Earth's interior
Surface waves travel along Earth's surface
P-waves are the fastest seismic waves and move in push-pull motion
S-waves are slower body waves with side-to-side motion
Love waves move side to side on the ground surface
Rayleigh waves cause the shaking felt during an earthquake
Earth's interior has four main layers: crust, mantle, outer core, and inner core
The crust is the outermost layer of Earth
The mantle is a semi-solid and semi-liquid layer
The inner core is the innermost and hottest part of Earth
Tsunamis can be produced by sudden vertical movement of underwater faults
